title: Kneel, Don't Sit
author: William Saville
content:
"Sit down and shut up,
Know your place,"
But you're the reason,
Our country is a disgrace.
Voting voting,
Closer to evil,
When we vote the lesser,
We eventually get upheaval.
Dictator dictator,
Wannabe,
Always on Twitter,
For all to see.
I see you my loving friends,
And doting family,
Ignoring the pleas of the poor,
While you dine happily?
It's not all for sure,
But any is too much,
Using your hate,
As your crutch.
Build the wall,
Stand up and pledge,
Why do we praise,
A country on the edge?
